What is real about this walkthrough?

The navigation and selection labels are based on the connector workflow. The financial grid's structure and visual treatment follow a supplied UX reference: QTD / prior-year / YTD groups, blue headers, orange emphasis, white cells, bold subtotals and text-only conditional formatting. All financial values, owner names and commentary are fictional. No customer screenshot or financial data is embedded here.

Try the hierarchy's “Only This” controls, select an owner or period, and compare the Sheet with its source. Refresh rereads the same local sample; it does not invent a timed data change. This walkthrough is self-paced and has no audio.
